name: What permits are required for driveway installation in Pasadena?

mainEntity.name: What permits are required for driveway installation in Pasadena?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Pasadena, driveway installation or significant alteration often requires permits from the City's Planning and Building Departments. This typically includes permits for grading, stormwater management, and sometimes encroachment permits if the work affects public right-of-way. The specific requirements depend on the scope of the project, material choices (e.g., permeable surfaces might have different regulations), and property zoning. Our team assists clients in navigating the local permitting process, ensuring all necessary approvals are secured before construction begins to avoid delays and compliance issues.
